jamie: Quick heads up — we're greenlit to publish the benchmark + blog at 3:00pm PT today. Need messaging checklist + ops standby for expected social traffic. Can @sophia @liam please confirm?

sophia: On it. I'll share the blog hero assets and the one-line boiler for press channels. ETA 20m. Preparing social package. :rocket:

liam: I'll schedule a canary deploy for the visualization service at 2:30pm PT and monitor mem/cpu. Ops team on standby.

ops-bot: Publish workflow queued: jobs/bench-blog-publish #1234 — ETA 15m. Watch logs at https://ci.internal/jobs/1234

tara: PR team — I'll ping top-tier reporters list and hold embargo lift until we confirm final artifact tests. Draft email ready.

jamie: Checklist: 1) Assets uploaded ✅ 2) Canary pass by 2:45 ✅/pending 3) CDN purge script ready 4) Social copy approved 5) Oncall (eng) watching. If anything fails, hit me and we'll roll to fallback model variant. Tweet draft below — LMK.

```
New: Redwood Inference publishes benchmark showing 3x throughput improvements for long-context models. Read more: https://redwood.ai/blog/bench-2026
```

liam: Canary logs show 2 minor 502 spikes between 2:36–2:38, but auto-retry smoothed. I'll keep monitoring. If spikes >0.5% for 5m, we'll pause deploy and alert.

sophia: Social ready. Final approval from jamie? :eyes: 

jamie: Approved. Go live at 15:00 PT. @ops-bot please proceed with publish at scheduled time. I'll be in #release-war-room.
